achievements.name: Hunter in the Forest
achievements.description: Unlock the Spirit Bow, gained partway through the Forest area; it powers many later combat challenges.

achievements.name: Harness Your Power
achievements.description: Unlock the Rot Bomb ability, which lets the Rot lob explosives to detonate objects and stagger heavy enemies.

achievements.name: Crossing Over
achievements.description: Unlock the Dash ability, Kena's forward dodge used for both traversal and combat.

achievements.name: Found a Friend
achievements.description: Find the first Rot.

achievements.name: Haikyo
achievements.description: Discover the Village.

achievements.name: Into the Woods
achievements.description: Discover the Forest.

achievements.name: The Open Range
achievements.description: Discover the Farm.

achievements.name: The Lonely Path
achievements.description: Reach the Mountain Shrine.

achievements.name: Taro's Fear
achievements.description: Collect the relic Taro's Knife, found along Taro's questline in the Forgotten Forest.

achievements.name: Taro's Regret
achievements.description: Collect the relic Taro's Lantern, earned after the Corrupt Taro boss fight.

achievements.name: Taro's Love
achievements.description: Collect Taro's food-offering relic, the last of the three memories tied to the lost boy Taro.

achievements.name: Adira's Love
achievements.description: Collect the Ox relic tied to the Woodsmith Adira's memories.

achievements.name: Adira's Fear
achievements.description: Collect Adira's Hammer relic, found along the Woodsmith's questline.

achievements.name: Adira's Regret
achievements.description: Collect the Village Heart relic, the third of Adira's three memories.

achievements.name: Toshi's Love
achievements.description: Collect the Village Crest relic tied to the village leader Toshi's memories.

achievements.name: Toshi's Fear
achievements.description: Collect Toshi's Incense relic, found on his questline near the Mountain Shrine.

achievements.name: Toshi's Regret
achievements.description: Collect Toshi's Harpoon relic, the last of his three memories.

achievements.name: Spirit Guide
achievements.description: Defeat Corrupt Taro and free his spirit - the game's first major boss, described here spoiler-free.

achievements.name: A Heavy Hammer
achievements.description: Defeat the Corrupt Woodsmith boss and free Adira's spirit, described here spoiler-free.

achievements.name: A Leader Walks Alone
achievements.description: Defeat the Corrupt Toshi boss, described here spoiler-free.

achievements.name: Restore Balance
achievements.description: Defeat the final boss and restore balance to the mountain - the end of the story, described here spoiler-free.

achievements.name: Piercing Blow
achievements.description: Hit 3 Enemies with a single Rot Infused Arrow.

achievements.name: Weigh Them Down
achievements.description: Destroy a Moth enemy with a Bomb.

achievements.name: Quick Draw
achievements.description: Hit 3 critical hit spots in 3 seconds.

achievements.name: Bow Master
achievements.description: Hit 3 enemies with a single Multi-shot.

achievements.name: Sharpshooter
achievements.description: Destroy an enemy by shooting a Bomb out of the air.

achievements.name: Between the Eyes
achievements.description: Destroy a Shield Sticks without breaking its shield.

achievements.name: Return to Sender
achievements.description: Destroy a Mage with its own bomb.

achievements.name: Triple Threat
achievements.description: Destroy 3 enemies with a single Parry.

achievements.name: Rot Commander
achievements.description: Use 5 Rot Actions in a single combat.

achievements.name: Triple Tap
achievements.description: Destroy 3 enemies with a single dash attack.

achievements.name: No Stone Unturned
achievements.description: Find all of the Rot.

achievements.name: Hat Collector
achievements.description: Collect 50 Rot Hats.

achievements.name: Curse Collector
achievements.description: Open all Cursed Chests.

achievements.name: Skillful Spirit Guide
achievements.description: Unlock all ability upgrades.

achievements.name: Good as New
achievements.description: Restore a Flower Shrine.

achievements.name: Restoration Master
achievements.description: Restore all of the Flower Shrines.

achievements.name: Zen Master
achievements.description: Meditate at all Meditation Spots.

achievements.name: The Last Stop
achievements.description: Deliver all Spirit Mail.

achievements.name: Say Cheese
achievements.description: Capture a picture in Photo Mode.

achievements.name: Master Spirit Guide
achievements.description: Beat the game on Master difficulty.
